# Threshold issues with Financing Statements

_Category: Known Bugs · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**trish.reimer** (12/22/2021):

**Threshold Number**
The threshold number for financing statements is 75 financing statements on the new platform. Anything over 75 financing statement requires a callback URL, which is being tested in our development environment and will be deployed into sandbox within the next couple of weeks (as of Dec 20)
